candidates.title: All of a Sudden
candidates.overview: Director of a care facility for the elderly, Marie-Lou strives to introduce an innovative care philosophy based on listening and respecting residents’ dignity, despite resistance from part of her staff. Her encounter with Mari, a Japanese theater director battling cancer, will profoundly reshape her path. By forming a deep, supportive friendship, the two women join forces in a shared struggle to make the impossible possible.

candidates.title: Focker In-Law
candidates.overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, aims to marry Olivia, a strong-willed former hostage negotiator who appears to be his complete mismatch. To Greg's shock, father-in-law Jack Byrnes takes a liking to Olivia, and her unprecedented rise into his Circle of Trust sparks chaos in the family before Jack's 80th birthday party.

candidates.title: Hershey
candidates.overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s children in need.

candidates.title: Hexed
candidates.overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

candidates.title: Lilo & Scratch
candidates.overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

candidates.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
candidates.original_title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
candidates.overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

candidates.title: 14th
candidates.overview: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

candidates.title: Ben'Imana
candidates.overview: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.

candidates.title: In Waves
candidates.overview: In Los Angeles, shy teenager AJ meets Kristen, who lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

candidates.title: Ka Kaa Ki Kii..
candidates.overview: Weary of years of neglect, a band of four complete misfits unwillingly teams up to save their village and loved ones. What ensues is absolute madness, chaos, and a riot of laughter as they defy the odds while discovering compassion, forgiveness, and friendship along the way.

candidates.title: Tangles
candidates.overview: A young woman is forced to return to the conservative small town where her bizarre family lives to take care of her mother, having to deal with the cruel reality of her mom's Alzheimer disease and become the daughter they need.

candidates.title: What Happened On November 1st?
candidates.overview: A whole college skips the second day of Halloweekend to celebrate Christmas on November 1st. Dressing festive, watching Christmas movies and playing music. However, there's a mystery...why and how are people getting murdered on November 1st?

candidates.title: Who Is Still Alive
candidates.overview: A map of Gaza, its towns, camps and neighbourhoods. White paint on a black ground. Within the crudely drawn outlines, nine refugees who escaped the inferno tell their stories.

candidates.title: my hamster video
candidates.overview: My hamster likes to eat, drink water, and run.

candidates.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express: Live On-Stage
candidates.original_title: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express: Live On-Stage
candidates.overview: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express races back onto the stage in a spectacular new production, where trains come to life, dreams are on the line, and only one can become champion.

candidates.title: The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's
candidates.overview: When a cosmic warp strikes a commuter tracks, a stylish teenager named Dorthy Ross ( Soroya Clayton-Wright) and her trusty dog poodle Smarty  are transported from the ordinary world straight into Stardust City—a glittering, neon-lit fantasy metropolis. Arriving in style aboard a custom-built, purple clockwork locomotive, she is greeted by the glamorous The Good Witch of the South ( Joh'Vonnie Monroe ), who welcomes her with a show-stopping musical number.  But the party is short-lived. Armed with a pink shirt, a purple poodle skirt, and a magical pair of silver slippers, the young trendsetter must navigate the dangers of the Yellow Brick Road after the Wicked Witch crashes the celebration. Packed with high-fashion aesthetics, explosive blue-diamond wand fireworks, and a soulful, show-stopping soundtrack, The Wonderful Wizard of Ha's is a bold, comedic, and modern reimagining of L. Frank Baum’s classic 1900 tale.

candidates.title: A Dot in the Ocean
candidates.overview: A Dot in the Ocean is a gripping documentary that transports viewers to the breathtaking, vibrant shores of Utila, Honduras - until an astonishing discovery deep within the mangroves changes everything, leaving audiences questioning what lies hidden just out of sight.

candidates.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
candidates.overview: At just 16, Soraya is already creating stunning drawings and sculptures that are as beautiful as they are dark. This strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator has been trying for five years to escape Iran and join her mother in Austria.

candidates.title: GROTESQQQUE
candidates.overview: An alien girl wants to be her planet's ambassador to be able to present herself on Earth. A group of high school students take part in a violent battle royale game called The Queen of Butterflies. A pure-blooded, female vampire lives with her servants in a world where humanity has become extinct.

candidates.title: Prince: 3121 Las Vegas Live
candidates.overview: Prepare for an electrifying, once in a lifetime concert experience as Prince commands the stage in 3121 Las Vegas Live. At the height of his legendary Las Vegas residency, Prince delivers a breathtaking showcase of unparalleled musicianship, explosive energy, dazzling guitar work, and unforgettable performances. Blending funk, rock, soul, R&B, and pop, he tears through hits, fan favorites, deep cuts, and extended jams with the spontaneity and brilliance that defined Prince as one of the greatest performers of all time. Whether you've been a lifelong Prince fan or are discovering his genius for the first time, this is Prince unleashed, and an essential experience for every generation.

candidates.title: 1-DAY ADULT
candidates.overview: So, essentially, from what I can glean, the “Minions” are a series of films about these little yellow creatures, a sickly old man and also his wife (?). They sing and dance to popular songs and they have all been very friendly to me. This is a film about a theme park in Singapore.

candidates.title: A Little Dream of Me
candidates.original_title: Cảm Ơn Người Đã Thức Cùng Tôi
candidates.overview: Cảm Ơn Người Đã Thức Cùng Tôi is an emotional journey of young people searching for answers to the question, “What is your dream?”—only to discover, as they step into adulthood, that the most important question becomes, “Who do you want to pursue that dream with?”

candidates.title: A Long Winter
candidates.overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

candidates.title: Above the Below
candidates.overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

candidates.title: Alias Rukmini
candidates.overview: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.

candidates.title: Behemoth!
candidates.overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

candidates.title: De Gaulle: Liberté
candidates.original_title: La Bataille de Gaulle : J'écris ton nom
candidates.overview: While World War II is raging, General De Gaulle seeks to convince the world that the battle for France not lost. Reality seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

candidates.title: Demon Dancer: Sua/Nara
candidates.overview: After tragedy shatters her life, a professional ballerina allows a demon to possess her—transforming her body, movement, and rage into a deadly weapon.

candidates.title: Eternal Return
candidates.overview: In this timeless romance, Cass (Naomi Scott) is resigned to a life without love until she meets Virgil (Kit Harington), a mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming

candidates.title: Flavia
candidates.overview: The adventures of 11-year-old Flavia de Luce, who is both an amateur detective and a master poisoner. When she discovers a dead body in her family’s decaying British manor house and her father is accused of the murder, Flavia launches her own investigation to uncover family secrets and bring the true murderer to justice.

candidates.title: GAME
candidates.overview: Late summer 1993. After stealing a stash of money and drugs, aging raver David crashes his car deep in the woods - trapped in the wreckage, injured and helpless, he hangs suspended between life and death. When a mysterious poacher discovers him, no rescue comes, only a watchful, unsettling presence that seems intent on letting nature finish the job. As the hours stretch and the elements close in, a tense and claustrophobic battle of wills, and wits, unfolds - where survival hinges on outlasting both the wilderness and the predator at its edge.​

candidates.title: Games We Play
candidates.overview: Imogen accompanies her boyfriend Jack and his two childhood best friends on a weekend getaway. There, she must participate in a tournament of high-stakes games, leading her to question her sanity and her safety.

candidates.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
candidates.overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

candidates.title: Jane Elliott Against the World
candidates.overview: A rural Iowa schoolteacher becomes a national voice against racism after leading a controversial 1968 lesson in discrimination with her all-white third-grade class. Now nearly 90, she refuses to hold back amid today’s fights about race, history, and power after a lifetime of speaking out.

candidates.title: November 1963
candidates.overview: Prior to the election of John F. Kennedy in 1960, his father Joe Kennedy asked for a favor from mob boss Sam Giancana and the Chicago Outfit to ensure a win for the younger Kennedy. However, during the presidency, the national organized crime syndicate came under heavy fire from Attorney General Bobby Kennedy. The mob answered this perceived betrayal with the ultimate revenge: the assassination of the 35th President of the United States on November 22, 1963. The events are depicted through the perspective of Sam Giancana's brother, Pepe, who was present during the critical planning stages, detailing the intricate circumstances and the mob's direct involvement in setting up the assassination.

candidates.title: Ray Gunn
candidates.overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

candidates.title: The Fox
candidates.overview: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

candidates.title: The Friend's House is Here
candidates.overview: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

candidates.title: The Gallerist
candidates.overview: Set against the glittering excess of Art Basel Miami, a desperate gallery owner conspires to pass off an accidental corpse as the centerpiece of her debut show.

candidates.title: Violent Night 2
candidates.overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

candidates.title: Daughters of the Late Colonel
candidates.overview: After the death of their ill-tempered and controlling father, two middle-aged sisters find themselves at a loss.  An unexpected visitor sparks the courage in them to begin their lives anew.. ‘Daughters of the Late Colonel’ is a merry, rude, and lyrical, animated adaptation of the modernist short story of the same name, written by Katherine Mansfield in 1920.

candidates.title: Precipice
candidates.overview: A profoundly working-class community with an intense connection to its land and water is transformed into a pleasure paradise for the wealthy…all while the ground slips into the sea. A feature documentary, PRECIPICE focuses on the intersection between climate change and a changing shore community’s response to this global emergency.

candidates.title: Seldom Seen
candidates.overview: Final entry in Sandman Series trilogy.

candidates.title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
candidates.original_title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
candidates.overview: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

candidates.title: Kamusta, Mahal?
candidates.overview: Kairo Lopez Mendoza becomes friends with their new transferee Daniel Francis Santos, until their friendship turns into a romantic relationship. When suddenly Daniel gets into a car accident and unfortunately passes away, Kairo is left with the pain of losing his greatest love. Influenced by his peers,  Hanz and James to try a drug to relieve his pain and depression from losing Daniel.

candidates.title: Cuckoo's Nest
candidates.overview: 72 hours after her mother disappears, a young girl watches her father descend into madness after he comes across a strange egg in their chicken coop.

candidates.title: Subway City
candidates.overview: 3.5 million travelers use the New York subway system every day. Briefcase wielding city workers share their morning rides with peddlers, street musicians, the down and out, pickpockets, and drug addicts. This film explores the underground world in all its diversity, from the frenetic rush hour traffic to the eerie solitude of early morning runs. Besides those who merely use the subway as transportation, there are those who work there, those who live there, and those who commit crimes there.

candidates.title: The Test
candidates.overview: Caught between a pro bono murder investigation and a law school reunion, Mike Leonardo reconnects with classmates for a weekend to celebrate the past. But when buried secrets surface the reunion curdles into something far more dangerous.

candidates.title: The Jungle
candidates.overview: Mariah is stuck in a self-destructive cycle of partying until she reconnects with an old friend who helps her rediscover her identity.

candidates.title: American Baby
candidates.overview: Oli becomes an outcast in her community when she gets pregnant at 15. As she seeks out the suddenly absent teenage father-to-be, Oli confronts the growing isolation from her community.

candidates.title: As Good As Dead 2
candidates.overview: After his Mexico assassins fail to eliminate DEA Agent Bryant Powell (Michael Jai White), Sonny Kilbane (Tom Berenger) is put on the hit list by his deep state former partners. Bryant must now break his former enemy out of prison and get him to safety, so he can testify, with assassins hot on their tails both north and south of the border.

candidates.title: Bunker
candidates.overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

candidates.title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
candidates.original_title: Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
candidates.overview: Michaela tries her best to be a good person.

candidates.title: Clarissa
candidates.overview: Across a single day in Lagos, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

candidates.title: Duped (The Jezbel Experience)
candidates.overview: Alexandria Wright meets Elijah Martinez and the demonic journey begins. Elijah Martinez finds himself ensnared in a romantic involvement with Alexandria Wright, an unfaithful Covert Narcissist. She convinces him they are soulmates and they take a vow before God for His blessing with the penalty of betrayal being death. After years pass, Alexandria forgets the vows and begins cheating behind Elijah's back. Just a week before Christmas, she abruptly betrays him. To his astonishment, she swiftly transitions to a new relationship, bringing with her the unsettling secret of transmitting an incurable sexually transmitted disease to her new partner. Then came Karma. Her victims arrive to spit on her dirty grave as her demise finally arrives.

candidates.title: Finding Faith
candidates.overview: A short film contextualising the cultural significance of George Michael's Faith album via unheard interview voice-over, unseen images by Herb Ritts, and behind-the-scenes footage of the Faith music video.

candidates.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
candidates.overview: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

candidates.title: Ink
candidates.overview: After buying a struggling British tabloid in 1969, mogul Rupert Murdoch and editor Larry Lamb band together a group of misfits and visionaries to reshape the image of the news industry as we know it.

candidates.title: Killing Castro
candidates.overview: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

candidates.title: Rose
candidates.overview: In the early 17th century, a soldier arrives at an isolated Protestant village in Germany claiming to be the heir to an abandoned farmstead. Even though he proves to be a good man, the villagers’ suspicions about his identity grow and they force a reckoning.

candidates.title: Rose Hobart 2
candidates.overview: Rose Hobart haunts the cinema.

candidates.title: Sindure Jatra
candidates.overview: A gambler risks his marriage by staking his wife in a high-stakes game, only to lose her and face a painful struggle for redemption as he confronts his addiction, pride, and the consequences of his actions.

candidates.title: Straight Circle
candidates.overview: A pair of enemy soldiers stationed on a remote border in a vast featureless desert descend into a state of profound disorientation after forgetting which side of the border is which. As they grapple with their identities, loyalties, and the absurdity of their situation, their isolation slowly gives way to an unfathomable nightmare that will blur the line between friend and foe.

candidates.title: Summer School, 2001
candidates.overview: A teenage boy returns to his family after years apart, scarred from being sent to Vietnam while his younger brother stayed in Czechia. After reunion, he faces a distant father, a mother desperate to mend the past, and a brother uneasy about sharing the spotlight. One chaotic summer pushes them to their limits when the younger brother falls from a roof. Between misunderstandings and clumsy family dynamics, they learn that sometimes, healing begins by letting the cracks show.

candidates.title: Tender Loving Care
candidates.overview: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

candidates.title: The Debut
candidates.overview: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

candidates.title: The Holiday Trilogy
candidates.overview: Three interconnected tales of distorted human connection come together to form a melancholic portrait about the complicated emotions that surround the holidays.  Each chapter is shot by a different Los Angeles-based SOV (Shot-on-Video) filmmaker .

candidates.title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
candidates.original_title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
candidates.overview: A rich patriarch's delicate family falls apart when his youngest of four wives cannot have a child.

candidates.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
candidates.original_title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
candidates.overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

candidates.title: Just Relax
candidates.overview: A troubled young woman undergoes a supernatural meditation for memory loss and discovers something more twisted than she ever could have imagined.

candidates.title: Split Mica
candidates.overview: Finding themselves haunted by a similar monster, three New Mexicans reckon with the complexities of calling a place home.

candidates.title: Starlight
candidates.overview: Spanning multiple generations and continents, Starlight follows the poignant journeys of four main characters as they traverse the bittersweet chapters of their lives, culminating in their ultimate struggles to overcome overwhelming obstacles relating to cancer. Yet, the heart of the film lies beyond the disease itself; it is a narrative of hope celebrating the power and perseverance of the human spirit, embodied and personified by these characters and their ability to triumph spectacularly against all odds.

candidates.title: THIS SYMPHONY MAY CONTAIN HOPE.
candidates.overview: Filmed live at the Royal Albert Hall with 117 musicians and special appearances by her family, this concert film unfolds across four season-inspired acts as RAYE reimagines her album amid 11 nominations at the 2027 Grammy Awards.

candidates.title: Parallel
candidates.overview: An eleven-year-old boy discovers a secret project that completely shatters his understanding of reality. He must race to uncover the truth before the forces behind the operation alter his life forever.

candidates.title: The Day She Returns
candidates.overview: ​Having stepped back from acting after marriage and a subsequent divorce, actress Bae Jeongsu returns to the profession with a role in an independent film. As the film’s release approaches, she takes part in a series of press interviews, only to discover later, when asked to revisit those moments in her acting class, that she cannot clearly recall what was said.

candidates.title: Bad Medicine
candidates.overview: Bad Medicine follows the trail of hard evidence while laying out a step-by-step exposé of the tricks and tactics used to capture and control entire populations. Without understanding these methods we will remain vulnerable to future psychological operations.

candidates.title: To Hold a Mountain
candidates.overview: In the remote highlands of Montenegro, a shepherd mother and daughter proudly defend their ancestral mountain from the threat of becoming a NATO military training ground, stirring memories of the violence that shattered their family.

candidates.title: Avengers: Doomsday
candidates.overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

candidates.title: Dune: Part Three
candidates.overview: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

candidates.title: Gym “Hometown Hero” Doc
candidates.overview: Dylan Shwarting goes through his gym routine and shares his experience

candidates.title: La Gradiva
candidates.overview: Amid the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a group of French teenagers on a class trip to Naples grapple with anxiety and exhilaration ahead of their high school graduation.

candidates.title: Prodigal Son
candidates.overview: Aaron "Amadeus" Overlake is a visionary filmmaker revered for his genius but plagued by his own demons—a volatile alcoholic whose life is consumed by anger, controversy, and from a bitter heartbreak. As tabloids revel in his self-destruction, Aaron’s only anchor is his best friend, Santiago "Baron" Gonzalez, a charismatic actor fresh out of rehab, fighting to rebuild his career.  Bound by shared struggles and a tangled history, Aaron and Santiago navigate the toxic undercurrents of fame and friendship. As Aaron embarks on his next masterpiece, his chaotic life threatens to destroy everything he holds dear.

candidates.title: The Raven of Baltimore City
candidates.overview: After a deadly encounter with a purse snatcher, a comic-book-obsessed man  sets out to become a masked superhero, putting himself on course to discover his inner villain in this darkly comic crime film.

candidates.title: Without a Trace
candidates.overview: A criminal on the run attempts to break into a house for hiding. He realizes his escape will be far more difficult than originally planned.

candidates.title: Captain Bonanza!
candidates.overview: Daring hero Captain Bonanza -- né Hudson Hill -- uncovers a sinister plot surrounding three magic idols in the mystic Hudson Valley. But this scheme is far greater, and far deadlier, than he ever could have imagined.

candidates.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
candidates.overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet—surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

candidates.title: Dada
candidates.overview: A stylish and uncompromising underworld don aggressively conquers the lawless Mumbai streets, weaponizing his fierce trademark justice to systematically dismantle a lethal corporate criminal syndicate.

candidates.title: King
candidates.overview: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

candidates.title: Artificial
candidates.overview: In November 2023, amidst the height of a global AI boom, OpenAI co-founder Ilya Sutskever teamed with the company board to make one of the defining decisions that has drastically reshaped the company as we know it, the firing of current CEO Sam Altman. This controversial decision would lead to immense backlash, ultimately resulting in Altman's return five days later.

candidates.title: Bye Ol' Dentistry: Heal the Whole
candidates.original_title: Bye Ol' Dentistry: Heal the Whole
candidates.overview: The story follows the Lolli family as they embark on a global journey of biological dentistry, experiencing first-hand the innovative treatments that are reshaping oral and whole-body health. From safe, non-toxic materials to advanced procedures that restore vitality and wellness, every step reveals new possibilities for a healthier future. Bye Ol’ Dentistry brings audiences inside these family transformations, showing how dentistry is evolving into one of the most exciting frontiers in medicine today.

candidates.title: Coward
candidates.overview: Surrounded by brutality but bound by a tender intimacy, two World War I soldiers find a fragile sanctuary of love and art amid the shadows of the Belgian trenches.

candidates.title: Jumanji: Open World
candidates.overview: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us—as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

candidates.title: Mr. Irrelevant
candidates.overview: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

candidates.title: The Poolrooms
candidates.overview: A teenager trapped inside a seemingly endless aquatic labyrinth of swimming pools, towering waterslides, flooded corridors, and impossible architecture. As he ventures deeper into the surreal liminal maze and reality itself begins to unravel, a mysterious creature stalks him from beneath the water, forcing him to find a way out before he disappears forever.

candidates.title: Werwulf
candidates.overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

candidates.title: wyrdo
candidates.overview: A Christmas dinner party is interrupted by an uninvited guest.

candidates.title: KITTY, KITTY!
candidates.overview: An upcoming indie horror film based on Dr. Seuss ' The Cat in the Hat.

candidates.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN JAKARTA: LIVE VIEWING
candidates.original_title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN JAKARTA: LIVE VIEWING
candidates.overview: End the year with a spectacular finale: BTS LIVE in cinemas The record-breaking journey continues as BTS’s history-making tour across Asia makes its way to the big screen. Join BTS for the grand year-end finale in Jakarta in December and experience the breathtaking performances and electrifying energy of BTS’s stadium tour. Don't miss your chance to witness BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in all its glory in cinemas worldwide.

candidates.title: Apophis 2029
candidates.overview: On April 13, 2029, the asteroid Apophis will pass close enough to Earth, it will be below our satellites. It will dip below and pop back out.

candidates.title: Look Back
candidates.overview: Popular, outgoing Fujino is celebrated by her classmates for her funny comics in the class newspaper. One day, her teacher asks her to share the space with Kyomoto, a truant recluse whose beautiful artwork sparks a competitive fervor in Fujino. What starts as jealousy transforms when Fujino realizes their shared passion for drawing.

candidates.title: Narayan Pustika 2 - Endless
candidates.overview: This movie is the second part of the Narayana Pustika trilogy. In which there is a description of the troubles arising from the opening of the unimaginable door revealed by the great sages.

candidates.title: Live at Parish Park
candidates.overview: On a cool autumn day in a park in Orleans, Massachusetts, local busking fixture Kevin “Coyote” Linnehan gathers friends, acquaintances, and passing strangers to sing and tell stories. Between original songs and covers of old favorites, Kevin revisits his colorful past in the music and arts worlds of the 1970s and ’80s—from “the heart of Boston” to New York and Hollywood. His stories feature familiar names from classic rock lore: Asa Brebner, Andy Pratt, Jonathan Richman, Robin Lane, and Andy Summers. There at Kevin’s invitation is Carol, a photographer and friend from his New York days whom he hasn’t seen in years. The two recall shared adventures, former flames, and youthful ambitions. Kevin also explains how caring for his aging parents brought him to the Cape decades ago—and kept him there. Live at Parish Park is a funny, tender portrait of an artist with plenty to sing about—and an audience that takes neither his stories nor his set list lying down.

candidates.title: Pendulum
candidates.overview: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

candidates.title: Rocky Wake
candidates.overview: Elise, long estranged from her mother Megan, visits her as she lies on her deathbed. Her mother recounts a life-changing moment from the early 80s, her father’s devastating diagnosis and a serial killer stalking the town. Elise reconstructs her mother’s memories, drawing them closer as the night unfolds.

candidates.title: Starlight & You
candidates.overview: Lily and Peter is a modern romantic drama about timing, connection, and love tested by real life. When a quiet online connection pulls two people together, distance, delay, and unexpected loss challenge what they're building. As they choose to show up for one another, their bond deepens into a love shaped by family values, resilience, and emotional truth. Warm, intimate, and universally relatable, Lily and Peter is a character-driven love story made for audiences who believe the strongest romances are earned.

candidates.title: UK Holiday
candidates.overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

candidates.title: Light Pillar
candidates.overview: In the not-too-distant future, janitor Zha (Da Peng) tends the grounds of a bankrupt film studio, accompanied only by a cat who used to act in the studio’s movies. Unable to pay Zha’s salary, the studio’s owner offers him a virtual reality headset as partial compensation. Zha is soon drawn into a fantasy world, where he embarks on a romantic journey with a beautiful female player who promises him a ticket to the moon if he can get her the money for it. Set against the backdrop of a fading film industry, acclaimed animator Xu Zao makes a formally daring debut with Light Pillar, weaving hand-drawn animation and live action into a poignant meditation on one man's search for belonging.

candidates.title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
candidates.overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.

candidates.title: DISVENTURE CAMP 5 & 6: DOUBLE PREMIERE

The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

candidates.title: Slay Day

But when the town exhumes the body of the real Sadie Hawkins to unravel the truth behind her killing spree fifty years earlier, a malevolent force returns to the town.

candidates.title: The Last Resort

candidates.title: Wishful Thinking
candidates.overview: Julia, an ambitious game designer, and Charlie, a struggling musician, are at a loss for how to repair their volatile relationship. After attending a couples-therapy seminar run by mysterious twin healers, they find that the ups-and-downs of their relationship have supernatural effects on the world around them. With earthquakes, the stock market, and entire nations at risk, Charlie and Julia must confront whether their passionate love can survive amidst so much chaos.

candidates.title: Chase: A Documentary
candidates.overview: An intimate biographical look at Chase Pulumbarit, exploring his reality navigating an open bisexual identity, long before stepping into the local independent entertainment landscape. Driven by a deep, heartbreaking sense of isolation, the narrative captures the suffocating weight of expectations while living a truth he fears might break them.  The story dives into the profound loneliness of his daily life, tracing the bittersweet reality of staying authentic in a world that feels emotionally distant. It follows his fragile, late-night hustle as an unsigned dreamer, capturing the quiet despair of pouring his entire heart and pain into a blank screen, terrified that his voice will never be heard, and that he will always be left waiting at the doorstep of his dreams.

candidates.title: Babies
